claims.statement: All three strategies report feasible status with no constraint violations, yet every strategy also carries a substantial reported shortfall.

All three synthetic strategies report empty constraint lists and status feasible, yet their fill rates remain below two-thirds and the lead-time assumption states future sowing cannot cover earlier deliveries.
Open-field forecast context would not alter these results because protected cultivation has no direct rainfall yield modifier, yet all listed strategies leave delivery shortfall sizable.

Margin improves with area while fill rate stays below two-thirds, yet waste grows and the selected area reaches only 240 square meters with a fixed closing stock, leaving harvest timing as the dominant constraint on coverage.
rejection_reasons: Numerical text must be rendered from a tool result

claims.statement: All three strategy plans show no constraint violations and feasible status, yet the harvest shortfall remains present in each plan, indicating future sowing cannot close earlier delivery gaps under the declared lead-time assumption.

All three synthetic strategies report empty constraint lists and feasible status despite substantial reported shortfalls, and the declared lead time states future sowing cannot cover earlier deliveries, so independent backend checks should preserve these shortfalls and not treat full demand coverage as feasible.
